title: The rwb-comms template dependency, the two template operations, the approval fields and the approval-reference shape are not in the sources
source: _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD P4 Access and administration v3.md; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P4 Access and administration v3.md; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P6 Communications v2.md; _work/msr/plan/ownership.json (Ownership Map v1); 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1.md; 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (RWB-E8-010)
description: The template approval gate of rwb-access calls two rwb-comms operations, reads a version's state and author and records an approving role code, and none of these values is fixed by a source the story can use: the story's metadata carries no P6 contract dependency and the two P6 operations it consumes are not in its contract-dependency list; the read of one template by its id (GET /api/recovery/comms/v1/admin/templates/{templateId}) is not in the P6 appendix, which declares the list with a code filter and not a read by id; the request and answer field set of the approval and of the history, the type of each field and the record code of an approval are not stated; the shape of the approval reference is not stated; the template table of TSD P6 v2 T3.1 carries no author and no lifecycle state of its own, so the author of a version is read from the standard record column created_by and the state from the standard record column state of T3.0; and this story's pattern list carries no DP-07 and its contract-dependency list no RWB-P3-E1043-CON, so the product group a version carries cannot be validated against LOV-PRODUCT here.
evidence: FSD P4 v3 A2.21 names the journey, one validation rule (VR-P4-021-1) and one business rule (BR-P4-021) and no operation, no field and no state; TSD P4 v3 T6.3 states the author-and-approver rule with MSG-P7-002 and names no field of a template approval; TSD P6 v2 T3.1 lists the template, notice and merge_field columns with the standard record columns of T3.0, and appendix T-A the five P6 template operations API-P6-003 to API-P6-007, of which API-P6-004 uploads a version in state DRAFT and API-P6-006 takes a TemplateApproval request and answers a Template; the ownership map puts template, notice and merge_field in P6 (Architecture v5 slide 41) and lists GET /admin/templates, POST /admin/templates, GET /admin/templates/{templateId}/content and POST /admin/templates/{templateId}/approve, and no read of one template by id; Architecture v5 slide 14 gives rwb-access the two events AccessPolicyChanged and DoaLimitChanged and no template event; the legacy story RWB-E8-010 names two rule-version endpoints and the rule-versions base of the monolith, and no template endpoint at all.
proposed: Build the approval and the history against the P6 template contract and its fake, publish that contract with the P6 contract story of the legacy key, and add the missing C dependency (RWB-P6-... or the id the P6 split allocates) to the metadata at D1; fix the two rwb-access paths on /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/template-approvals and the request and answer field set in RWB-P4-E8010-CON; hold the approval-reference shape as a parameter row; take the approving role as a role code from role and permission; read the author of a version from the standard record column created_by and the state from the standard record column state, and write no template state here; answer the history from the local decision-record chain; carry the message ID MSG-P7-002 with its text left to the message catalogue; and let the P6 owner confirm the read-by-id path or supply the code filter it prefers on the list operation.
